# pocketfft

Header-only CPU FFT from https://github.com/mreineck/pocketfft (`cpp` branch).
BSD-3. Used for polar HEALPix RING FFTs. Not a public torchsky API.

- Vendored file: `pocketfft_hdronly.h`
- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/mreineck/pocketfft`
- Upstream branch: `cpp`
- Upstream commit: unknown; it was not recorded when this copy was vendored
- Vendoring date: unknown; it was not recorded when this copy was vendored
- Local modifications relative to upstream: unknown; no pristine upstream snapshot or commit was recorded
- Known source identity: the header identifies pocketfft, its authors, and copyright years through 2024
- License: BSD-3-Clause; the exact bundled notice is in `pocketfft.LICENSE.md` and the header
